sources.title: Tunnel Vision and Selective Attention
sources.scope_note: Observations of attention during tasks; does not show that any contextual signal will be noticed.

sources.title: Banner Blindness: Old and New Findings
sources.scope_note: Applied attention findings; not a universal rule about the position of all banners.

sources.title: Change Blindness in UX
sources.scope_note: Visible changes may go unnoticed. Does not replace tests in the real flow.

sources.title: Minimize Cognitive Load to Maximize Usability
sources.scope_note: Professional synthesis; distinguish avoidable effort from necessary complexity.

sources.title: The Aesthetic-Usability Effect
sources.scope_note: Perceived usability and tolerance of minor problems; does not prove that beauty solves blocked tasks.

sources.title: How Chunking Helps Content Processing
sources.scope_note: Contextual semantic grouping; not a fixed quota of items.

sources.title: Working Memory and External Memory
sources.scope_note: Offload memory through information the person can consult; does not replace an understandable domain model.

sources.title: Mental Models
sources.scope_note: Research user expectations; do not infer them from the technical model.

sources.title: The Paradox of the Active User
sources.scope_note: Contextual learning; does not assume that nobody reads documentation.

sources.title: Designing Complex Applications
sources.scope_note: Preserve the tasks and experience of expert users.

sources.title: Simplicity vs. Choice
sources.scope_note: Simplicity and capability must be balanced according to the task.

sources.title: Proximity Principle in Visual Design
sources.scope_note: Perceptual grouping; test that it matches the semantic relationship.

sources.title: Similarity Principle in Visual Design
sources.scope_note: Shared appearance suggests relationships; it does not create accessible semantics.

sources.title: Common Region: Gestalt Principle for UI Design
sources.scope_note: Visual containment; use it when the relationship warrants it, do not wrap everything in cards.

sources.title: The Peak–End Rule in UX
sources.scope_note: Retrospective memory is not the same as success on the whole task.

sources.title: The Pareto Principle in UX
sources.scope_note: Prioritize from real data; 80/20 is not a guaranteed ratio.

sources.title: The Power Law of Learning
sources.scope_note: Practice matters; does not predict individual learning curves without measurement.

sources.title: Decision Framing: Cognitive Bias and UX Professionals
sources.scope_note: Apply controls to the designer and the evaluator too, not only to the user.

sources.title: Cowan: The Magical Mystery Four
sources.scope_note: DOI 10.1177/0963721409359277. Capacity under memory conditions; not a navigation limit.

sources.title: Oberauer: Working Memory and Attention — A Conceptual Analysis and Review
sources.scope_note: DOI 10.5334/joc.58. PMC6688548 blocked direct access; not an audit of the whole review.

sources.title: Mattson: Superior pattern processing is the essence of the evolved human brain
sources.scope_note: Direct access blocked. Broad reference, NOT direct evidence for an interface pattern.

sources.title: Ghibellini & Meier: Interruption, recall and resumption
sources.scope_note: DOI 10.1057/s41599-025-05000-w. No general recall advantage for unfinished tasks; a tendency to resume them. Nature redirected to authentication.

sources.title: Kivetz, Urminsky & Zheng: The Goal-Gradient Hypothesis Resurrected
sources.scope_note: Experiments with specific rewards and tasks. Transfer to each product: a hypothesis to validate.

sources.title: Chernev, Böckenholt & Goodman: Choice overload — A conceptual review and meta-analysis
sources.scope_note: DOI 10.1016/j.jcps.2014.08.002. Moderators: complexity, task, preferences, and goal.

sources.title: Fitts: The information capacity of the human motor system
sources.scope_note: 1954 work, 1992 reprint. A movement model under conditions; does not compute all decision time.

sources.title: Hick: On the Rate of Gain of Information
sources.scope_note: DOI 10.1080/17470215208416600. Stimulus–response choice; not a rule for cutting every menu.

sources.title: Proctor & Schneider: Hick’s law for choice reaction time — A review
sources.scope_note: DOI 10.1080/17470218.2017.1322622. Practice, compatibility, and sequential dependencies matter.

sources.title: Murdock: The serial position effect of free recall
sources.scope_note: DOI 10.1037/h0045106. Classic free-recall work; full access not reviewed here.

sources.title: Tesler’s Law
sources.scope_note: Professional essay. A heuristic for distributing complexity, not physical conservation.

sources.title: Familiar vs Novel
sources.scope_note: Conventions as a starting point; not a mandate for aesthetic uniformity.

sources.title: Von Restorff Effect
sources.scope_note: Design synthesis. Application to CTAs and attention is treated as a hypothesis, not a guaranteed increase.

sources.title: Ramsey: Designing For Flow
sources.scope_note: Design essay, not an experimental study that validates a specific interface.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
sources.scope_note: Current Recommendation consulted. Audit the complete applicable criteria; no certification by checklist.

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.5.8: Target Size (Minimum)
sources.scope_note: 24×24 CSS px or exceptions, including spacing; do not confuse with the 44×44 of Enhanced AAA.

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.4.11: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
sources.scope_note: AA: not fully hidden by author content. Enhanced requirements are different.

sources.title: Making Content Usable for People with Cognitive and Learning Disabilities
sources.scope_note: Complementary guidance. Not an additional WCAG conformance requirement.

sources.title: WCAG 3 Introduction
sources.scope_note: W3C published new drafts in September 2026. They are still incomplete and do not replace WCAG 2; do not promise normative status in 2027.

sources.title: Amershi et al.: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
sources.scope_note: 18 guidelines; evaluated with practitioners and AI products, not a universal validation of generative agents.

sources.title: PAIR: Errors and Graceful Failures
sources.scope_note: Vendor guidance on failures, limits, and recovery paths.

sources.title: Buçinca, Malaya & Gajos: To Trust or to Think
sources.scope_note: Less overreliance under specific interventions, with subjective costs and differences between people.

sources.title: Microsoft: Overreliance on AI
sources.scope_note: Choose mitigations by user, task, and risk; explanation alone does not guarantee calibrated trust.

sources.title: Interaction to Next Paint
sources.scope_note: Good INP ≤200 ms at the 75th percentile of visits; does not measure the completion of remote work.

sources.title: Web Vitals
sources.scope_note: LCP, INP, and CLS are web metrics; they are not equivalent to the overall human experience.

sources.title: Rodden, Hutchinson & Fu: Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale
sources.scope_note: HEART and goal–signal–metric. Does not require measuring every category in every case.

sources.title: Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10
sources.scope_note: Community Group format; not a W3C Recommendation. Validate real tool support.

sources.title: RFC 9413: Maintaining Robust Protocols
sources.scope_note: Critique of ambiguous permissiveness in protocols. Application to forms is an explicit analogy.

sources.title: Agent Skills Specification
sources.scope_note: SKILL.md format and local resources; client compatibility must be verified.
